arm_description: Arm 1 - Exploratory study of anti-CD20 plus RV1001 (a novel PI3Kdelta inhibitor) in dogs with DLBCL
Arm 2 - Exploratory study of anti-CD20 plus KPT-9274 (non-competitive dual inhibitor of PAK4 and NAMPT) and Doxorubicin in dogs with DLBCL
Arm 3 - Biologic Activity of anti-CD20/TAK981 (a SUMO-activating enzyme inhibitor) in Canine Diffuse Large B Cell Lymphoma
Arm 4 - Exploratory study of Anti CD-20/RV1001  (a novel PI3Kdelta inhibitor)/Doxorubicin in dogs with DLBCL
Arm 5 - Exploratory study of anti-CD20 plus RV1001  (a novel PI3Kdelta inhibitor), KPT-9274 (non-competitive dual inhibitor of PAK4 and NAMPT) and Doxorubicin in dogs with DLBCL
Arm 6 - Biologic Activity of anti-CD20/TAK981 (a SUMO-activating enzyme inhibitor) in Canine Diffuse Large B Cell Lymphoma
Arm 7a - 20 mg/kg anti-CD20/DOX vs 20/10 mg/kg anti-CD20 with 7.5 mg/kg RV1001/4 mg/kg KPT-9274
Arm 7b - 20 mg/kg anti-CD20/DOX vs 20/10 mg/kg anti-CD20 with 7.5 mg/kg RV1001/4 mg/kg KPT-9274
